sentence_1_it: A proposito, ho qualcosa da dirti.
sentence_1_en: By the way, I have something to tell you.
sentence_2_it: A proposito, l'hai sentita da allora?
sentence_2_en: By the way, have you heard from her since then?
sentence_3_en: By the way, are you free tonight?

sentence_1_it: Che brava gente, pensò dentro di sé Pinocchio. E dimenticando suo padre, il cappotto nuovo, l'abbecedario, e tutti i suoi buoni propositi, disse alla Volpe e al Gatto: Andiamo. Sono con voi.
sentence_1_en: What good people, thought Pinocchio to himself. And forgetting his father, the new coat, the A-B-C book, and all his good resolutions, he said to the Fox and to the Cat: Let us go. I am with you.
